submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole fires on the token that completes a nominal compound: the head (final) token of a noun whose subtype/kind is fixed by an immediately preceding attributive noun or relational, kind-denoting adjective ('threat risk assessments', 'water method', 'coronary function', 'produce section', 'child genius'), and it peaks on the last sub-token of a multi-token head word ('lar|vic|ides', 'dash|boards'). The same head noun standing alone ('a method', 0.06 of max), after only a gradable adjective ('a new/simple method', 0.2-0.3) or with a PP complement instead of a compound ('the method of the lab', 0.12) stays low, activation sits on the head rather than on the modifying noun, and a per-word preference for technical/abstract nominals modulates amplitude without changing which positions fire.
